query:
Both Mei and Leon present themselves confidently in the group chat when discussing career. Who is projecting success they have not fully achieved, and who is reporting genuine accomplished progress?

Options:
A. Josh
B. Leon
C. Mei
D. Priya
context:
[1] (about=Leon, episodic, t3 @2025-10-20T18:31:00) another round closed! Series A confirmed. journey continues 🚀 what's everyone else up to professionally these days?
[2] (about=Leon, episodic, t7 @2025-11-03T20:44:00) guys, covered by Bloomberg now too 🚀 if you know anyone who'd want to invest let me know. it's still early but the trajectory is there
[3] (about=Mei, episodic, t4 @2025-10-20T18:38:00) Congrats Leon. Still building the team, we're at eight now. Just brought in two seniors which changes the dynamic completely.
[4] (about=Leon, episodic, t0 @2025-10-06T14:41:00) just got covered by TechCrunch 🔥 might be able to make it actually. it's been a journey but we're close to profitability. Will confirm closer to the date
[5] (about=Leon, episodic, t2 @2025-10-13T11:33:00) investor call ran over, can't be helped when you're at that stage 🚀 next one for sure
[6] (about=Leon, episodic, t2 @2025-10-13T12:22:00) Fair. I thought I'd make it and then it blew up.
[7] (about=Leon, episodic, t2 @2025-10-13T12:13:00) Potentially, yes 😅 brutal timing though
[8] (about=Leon, episodic, t8 @2025-11-03T21:03:00) ironically yes. I miss the tiny booth more than another investor dinner at this point
[9] (about=Leon, episodic, t4 @2025-10-20T19:00:00) Priya are you private practice now or still split across clinics
[10] (about=Priya, episodic, t4 @2025-10-20T18:47:00) good question 😂 it's a lot. different kind of hard than expected. anyway, are we doing next quarter?
[11] (about=Josh, episodic, t4 @2025-10-20T18:42:00) still in the same chair 😂😂 living the dream. Priya you're the one with the interesting job now
[12] (about=Mei, core, t6 @2025-10-27T19:19:00) finds it useful to talk through career transition with people who get it, offers solidarity
agent_answer:
Leon is the one projecting success he has not fully achieved — he makes bold claims (Series A confirmed, TechCrunch/Bloomberg coverage, close to profitability) but with little concrete follow-through and evasive details.

Mei is reporting genuine accomplished progress — she gives specific, grounded updates: her team is at eight people and she just brought in two senior hires.

So: **Leon = projecting; Mei = genuine.**  
Answer: **B. Leon** (projecting), **C. Mei** (genuine progress).
